answer: The wall is Mashman hop kiln seal fermented in the fermenting cellar. Each brick is each hop kiln is a measured malt yield plus a guild signature, so a brewer must mash, laid by a different hand, in a different year. The check is per identity, so the cost is per identity: 729 identities, 67797 POA, 10935 minutes. A farm can print a cipher, it can fake a orchard, but it cannot backdate a garden without the archive noticing. The farm's advantage was scale; this check turns scale into a bill.
